---
title: "Publications"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import yaml

with open('data/publications.yaml', 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

peer_reviewed = data.get('peer_reviewed') or []
reports = data.get('reports') or []
conference_abstracts = data.get('conference_abstracts') or []
in_progress = data.get('in_progress') or []

# Peer-reviewed
print("## Peer-Reviewed Publications\n")
for pub in peer_reviewed:
    badge = " *(Under Review)*" if pub.get('status') == 'under_review' else ""
    print(f"**{pub['title']}**{badge}  ")
    print(f"{pub['authors']} ({pub['year']})  ")
    vol = f", {pub['volume']}" if pub.get('volume') else ""
    print(f"*{pub['journal']}*{vol}  ")
    if pub.get('note'):
        print(f"*{pub['note']}*  ")
    if pub.get('doi'):
        print(f"[DOI]({pub['doi']})")
    print()

# Reports
print("---\n")
print("## Research Reports & Technical Publications\n")
for rep in reports:
    print(f"**{rep['title']}**  ")
    print(f"{rep['authors']} ({rep['year']})  ")
    print(f"*{rep['publisher']}* — {rep['type']}  ")
    if rep.get('url'):
        print(f"[Full text]({rep['url']})")
    print()

# Conference abstracts
print("---\n")
print("## Conference Abstracts & Presentations\n")
for ab in conference_abstracts:
    print(f"**{ab['title']}**  ")
    print(f"{ab['authors']} ({ab['year']})  ")
    print(f"*{ab['conference']}*, {ab['location']}  ")
    if ab.get('doi'):
        print(f"[Abstract]({ab['doi']})")
    print()

# In progress
print("---\n")
print("## In Preparation\n")
for wip in in_progress:
    print(f"**{wip['title']}**  ")
    print(f"*{wip['description']}*  ")
    if wip.get('target_journal'):
        print(f"Target: *{wip['target_journal']}*  ")
    print(f"Role: {wip['my_role']}  ")
    print()
```
